events.verdict: Siakam (IND) cleanly deflects the loose ball away from Randle (MIN).
Gobert (MIN) turns toward Sheppard (IND) but does not deliver contact during the pick.
Sheppard (IND) moves into DiVincenzo (MIN), initiating illegal arm/body contact during his driving shot attempt.
Bradley (IND) and Gobert (MIN) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Conley (MIN) initiates contact with Sheppard's (IND) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Bradley (IND) makes incidental contact with McDaniels' (MIN) arm as both players pursue the rebound.
Sheppard (IND) does not step out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.
Sheppard (IND) and McDaniels (MIN) come together at the same spot off of the ball and the ensuing foot contact is incidental.
Sheppard (IND) lowers his arm and makes more than marginal contact with Gobert's (MIN) head during his shot attempt at the rim.
Dennis (IND) makes clean contact to the ball as he defends Randle (MIN).
Randle (MIN) maintains his pivot foot before the timeout is recognized.
Dennis (IND) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Conley (MIN).
Randle (MIN) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) is not established in a legal guarding position in Randle's (MIN) path and Randle spins away from the marginal contact.
Randle (MIN) loses control control of the ball prior to the incidental contact to his arm by Dennis (IND).
Dennis (IND) reaches in and makes contact with the ball and any ensuing contact with McDaniels (MIN) is incidental.
Bradley (IND) establishes a screening position in McDaniels' (MIN) path and does not deliver contact.
DiVincenzo (MIN) and Sheppard (IND) briefly engage and disengage off of the ball.
Randle (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position during Siakam's (IND) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
DiVincenzo (MIN) pursues the loose ball and the contact with Nesmith's (IND) arm after he tips the ball is incidental.
DiVincenzo (MIN) moves forward into Nesmith (IND) and initiates contact to his body, which affects Nesmith's shot attempt near the basket.
Nesmith (IND) crosses the plane of the free throw line before his free throw attempt contacts the rim.
Dennis (IND) commits a take foul on Conley (MIN).
Conley (MIN) legally contests Nesmith's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Walker (IND) tips the ball and the ensuing contact by DiVincenzo (MIN) to his arm is marginal.
